ModMetaData.name: Jarimichus Beamwire
ModMetaData.author: Jarimichu
ModMetaData.description:
Wireless power over laser beams. Part of the Jarimichus series: see also Jarimichus Mining Laser and Jarimichus Laser Cannon, which Beamwire can power.
Build a beam emitter on one grid and a beam receiver on another, and the power flows between them through the air with no conduit in between. Aim and bend beams in 8 directions, diagonals included, with mirrors that turn them 90°. Split them with half-silvered splitters that share power according to demand, and carry them across the map with relays.
Features - Auto-aim: the network aims its own emitters, mirrors, splitters and relays so beams reach every receiver it can, re-aiming as you build. Rotate any node by hand to take manual control. - 8 beam nodes: emitter, receiver, mirror, splitter, prism, relay, safety shutter and capacitor, plus a beam window that lets beams through walls - Beams and nodes point in 8 directions (45° steps); mirrors turn beams 90° or bounce them back - Emitters only draw what the receivers need. A little power is lost at each bounce and over distance. - Walls and rock block beams. Fog, rain and smoke dim them, and roofs optionally block them. - Powered beams burn anyone in their path. You can turn this off, or route beams through your killbox. - Optics gather dust and need cleaning. Explosions can knock mirrors out of alignment. - With the Odyssey expansion: Beamwire optics standing in vacuum never gather dust. - Can power other mods' buildings through a small API: Jarimichus Mining Laser and Jarimichus Laser Cannon use it. - Thin, glowing laser visuals and an emitter hum - 3 art styles to choose from in the mod settings: Rim Standard, Hazard Industrial and Glitterworld Spacer - Its own research tab, tied into vanilla progression: Beam optics (needs Solar panels), Beam safety (Autodoors), Beam splitting (Microelectronics), Coherent relays (Fabrication) and Beam capacitors (Batteries). Later projects need a hi-tech research bench. - Compatible with Vanilla Expanded power mods (Beamwire uses the vanilla power net) and Combat Extended
